metadata.comparison: retained database-authorization baseline; same configured conditions, separately measured
metadata.conditions: exclusive PostgreSQL 17 container; tmpfs data; loopback TCP; one pooled measurement connection; 3 warmups then 10 samples; new-connection first call excludes connect time; DB/OS caches not flushed

queries.query: BEGIN
COMMIT
SELECT hole_number,par,stroke_index FROM holes WHERE tee_id=$1 AND hole_number<=$2 ORDER BY hole_number
SELECT id FROM singles_matches WHERE round_id=$1 ORDER BY first_player_id,second_player_id,id
SELECT id,first_player_id,second_player_id,revision,ledger,terminal,confirmed,correction_pending FROM singles_matches WHERE id=$1 AND round_id=$2

SELECT p.id AS player_id,p.display_name,s.playing_handicap FROM players p LEFT JOIN round_handicap_snapshots s ON s.player_id=p.id AND s.round_id=$1 WHERE p.id=ANY($2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.id=$3 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT player_id,hole_number,gross_strokes FROM singles_match_notes WHERE match_id=$1 AND hole_number<=$2 ORDER BY hole_number,player_id
SELECT playing_handicap FROM round_handicap_snapshots WHERE round_id=$1 AND player_id=$2

SELECT r.id,r.tournament_id,r.status,r.scoring_format,r.handicap_enabled,r.tee_id,r.round_number,t.number_of_rounds,t.final_round_back_nine_hidden FROM rounds r JOIN tournaments t ON t.id=r.tournament_id WHERE r.id=$1

SELECT rhs.player_id
         FROM round_handicap_snapshots rhs
         JOIN players p ON p.id = rhs.player_id
         WHERE rhs.round_id = $1
           AND (
             $2
             OR rhs.player_id = $3
             OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM flight_memberships actor_fm
               JOIN flight_memberships owner_fm
                 ON owner_fm.flight_id = actor_fm.flight_id
                AND owner_fm.round_id = actor_fm.round_id
                AND owner_fm.tournament_id = actor_fm.tournament_id
               WHERE actor_fm.round_id = $1
                 AND actor_fm.player_id = $3
                 AND owner_fm.player_id = rhs.player_id
             )
           )
         ORDER BY lower(p.display_name), p.id

SELECT role FROM tournament_memberships
         WHERE tournament_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 FOR SHARE

SELECT s.id AS session_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.role,
                u.player_id, s.expires_at
         FROM user_sessions s
         JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
         WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
           AND s.credential_generation = u.credential_generation
         FOR SHARE OF s, u

SELECT hole_number,par,stroke_index FROM holes WHERE tee_id=$1 AND hole_number<=$2 ORDER BY hole_number
SELECT id FROM singles_matches WHERE round_id=$1 AND (first_player_id=$2 OR second_player_id=$2) ORDER BY first_player_id,second_player_id,id
SELECT id,first_player_id,second_player_id,revision,ledger,terminal,confirmed,correction_pending FROM singles_matches WHERE id=$1 AND round_id=$2

SELECT p.id AS player_id,p.display_name,s.playing_handicap FROM players p LEFT JOIN round_handicap_snapshots s ON s.player_id=p.id AND s.round_id=$1 WHERE p.id=ANY($2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.id=$3 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT player_id,hole_number,gross_strokes FROM singles_match_notes WHERE match_id=$1 AND hole_number<=$2 ORDER BY hole_number,player_id
SELECT playing_handicap FROM round_handicap_snapshots WHERE round_id=$1 AND player_id=$2

SELECT r.id,r.tournament_id,r.status,r.scoring_format,r.handicap_enabled,r.tee_id,r.round_number,t.number_of_rounds,t.final_round_back_nine_hidden FROM rounds r JOIN tournaments t ON t.id=r.tournament_id WHERE r.id=$1

SELECT role FROM tournament_memberships
         WHERE tournament_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 FOR SHARE

SELECT s.id AS session_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.role,
                u.player_id, s.expires_at
         FROM user_sessions s
         JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
         WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
           AND s.credential_generation = u.credential_generation
         FOR SHARE OF s, u
SELECT stroke_index FROM holes WHERE tee_id=$1 ORDER BY hole_number

SELECT rhs.player_id
         FROM round_handicap_snapshots rhs
         JOIN players p ON p.id = rhs.player_id
         WHERE rhs.round_id = $1
           AND (
             $2
             OR rhs.player_id = $3
             OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM flight_memberships actor_fm
               JOIN flight_memberships owner_fm
                 ON owner_fm.flight_id = actor_fm.flight_id
                AND owner_fm.round_id = actor_fm.round_id
                AND owner_fm.tournament_id = actor_fm.tournament_id
               WHERE actor_fm.round_id = $1
                 AND actor_fm.player_id = $3
                 AND owner_fm.player_id = rhs.player_id
             )
           )
         ORDER BY lower(p.display_name), p.id

SELECT role FROM tournament_memberships
         WHERE tournament_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 FOR SHARE

                u.player_id, s.expires_at

         JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
